zero_pulse_association.method: candidate_diagnostics.plan_time + cycle_ms/1000 approximates reject time; reject() publishes zero before diagnostics/status. Bag receipt times for topics may differ. This approximation can be affected by delays before diagnostics capture and subscriber queues.
zero_pulse_association.caveat: One native_reference_expired_before_delivery pulse (90.7 ms) is terminal transition, not sustained tracking interruption. Two larger estimate offsets need timing caution.

snapshot_input_rejections.caveat: Snapshot diagnostics are current data read after rejection; may differ from exact snapshot checked at failure. Input branch also checks live base/joint stamps.

position_goal.note: Bag odom sample last before finish, world/odom aligned here as planner feedback; this is approximate, not independent ground truth.

conclusions: Single goal emitted one polynomial trajectory and completed; no repeated replans or abort in this navigation window.
Main direct command interruption is rejected cycles publishing zero, with 59 snapshot/input age failures compared with 8 planning/delivery deadline failures.
51 nonzero-zero-nonzero command pulses totaled 9.039 s (one is expected terminal expiry transition); this is command duration, not proof wheels fully stopped for the same duration.
Nominal accepted commands all had 3 feasible candidates; no no_feasible_candidate, collision_checked_command_rejected, or zero safety limit observed.
Piper remained enabled and unlatched with feedback_valid; command_active temporarily false shows expired command stream, not motor disable.

Reference progress slowed with base tracking lag (median scale 0.262), extending a 9.348 s virtual trajectory to 29.413 s goal completion. This is a response to tracking lag, not by itself proof of its initiating cause.
